china_race_dynamics.text: We recently met with representatives from ControlAI, a nonprofit organization focused on the safe development and governance of artificial intelligence, to discuss the rapid advancement of AI and the emergence of artificial superintelligence (ASI). Our conversation focused on the growing national security implications of ASI and the important role Congress will play in shaping policies that encourage innovation while ensuring these technologies are developed responsibly. [...] AI is increasingly becoming a strategic issue in the competition between the United States and China, and it is essential that America remains the global leader in this critical technology while putting appropriate safeguards in place.

deepseek.reason: The speaker says AI competition between the US and China is strategic and America must remain the global leader while safeguarding the technology.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly combines US-China competition as a priority with a call for appropriate safeguards.
